Overview

Glendale is a city in AZ with a population of 249,081. Phoenix suburb with spring training, Westgate entertainment, and desert affordability. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 296 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.5.
